objective: Test whether the one frozen GIN representation adds CYP ranking value beyond fixed MapLight features on the existing 18 shadow cells.

feature_contract.fixed_nan_rule: Preserve only the D-027 charge-descriptor NaNs unchanged; CatBoost resolves nan_mode=Min.
feature_contract.gin_finiteness: All GIN values must be finite.
feature_contract.repeat_gate: Both fixed roots and both GIN roots must have byte-identical row and array payloads before fitting.

controls.shuffle: Use one NumPy default_rng permutation of the 15399 unique exact-raw GIN vectors, then expand the permuted mapping to every official row. Exact-raw duplicates receive the same shuffled vector.
controls.noise: Use one NumPy default_rng standard-normal float64 matrix with shape 15399 by 300 in the same sorted exact-raw order, then expand it to every official row. Exact-raw duplicates receive the same noise vector.
invariants: the unshuffled GIN matrix is never modified
the shuffle is a whole-vector permutation without replacement
noise is generated independently of structures and targets
controls are generated before any validation target is available

model_contract.other_parameters: Pinned CatBoost 1.2.1 defaults, including resolved nan_mode=Min.
model_contract.derived_prediction: Arithmetic mean of the five b2 probability vectors, retained separately from the five seed vectors.

model_cell_process_may_read: the two reviewed fixed feature roots
the two reviewed GIN feature roots
this contract and its parent contracts
prediction_firewall.chronology: All 18 prediction cells and their receipts must be immutable and reviewed before the scoring target is opened.

evaluation_contract.fixed_predictions: Reuse the immutable Stage A R5 seed-1 and five-seed mean probabilities; do not refit fixed MapLight.
evaluation_contract.primary_contrast: b2 seed 1 minus Stage A R5 seed 1
control_contrasts: b2 seed 1 minus b3 shuffled GIN seed 1
b2 seed 1 minus b4 random-noise seed 1
evaluation_contract.point_metric: full-precision average precision on each frozen outer-validation cell
sensitivity_populations: validation rows with no training neighbor at or above 0.60
keep_gate: paired macro lower 95 percent bound above zero in both protocols
at least two CYP tasks improve
the remaining task loses no more than 0.005 AUPRC
shuffled GIN and random noise do not reproduce the gain
direction survives every declared sensitivity population
no single scaffold or community explains the result

stop_rules: stop before fitting on any hash row alignment dimension dtype finiteness environment or firewall mismatch
stop after a prediction failure and retain one blocker; do not repair after a score
stop performance work for the mandatory forensic audit if any point AUPRC is at least 0.95
do not score before an independent prediction-artifact review
do not consume a public-test family-task slot
